title: Statistics area file (v1/stats/area/YYYY.json)
description: One year of events on a 0.1-degree grid for Your area: per occupied cell (row = min(1799, floor((latE4 + 900000) / 1000)), col = floor(((lonE4 + 1800000) mod 3600000) / 1000), cell = row * 3600 + col; delta-coded, strictly increasing) the event count, the M4.5+ count and the largest magnitude x 100 of its events, plus the M6+ events as an event table of kind "area". min_mag 4.5 (era B) means every record is M4.5+. Built by stats.yml, committed on data at the same path. APIs.md, Statistics.
